allow: Shell(git commit -F - <<'EOF' backend: Express HTTP API — auth, workspaces, quotes, public links, reports, OpenAPI EOF)

Shell(powershell -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:3000/health; Write-Output ('health=' + ($h | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)) } catch { Write-Output ('ERR: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }")

Shell(powershell -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5173/ -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('frontend up') } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode -eq 302 -or $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__ -eq 200) { Write-Output 'frontend up (redirect)' } else { Write-Output ('ERR: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }; try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5173/health; Write-Output ('proxy health=' + ($h | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)) } catch { Write-Output ('proxy ERR: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }")
